user.title: Wisniowski Connected
user.description:
Open this authorization URL in a new browser tab and sign in with your Wisniowski Connected account. The final page may be blank; this is expected. Copy the full final URL from the browser address bar and paste it below.

{authorization_url}

dhcp_confirm.title: Wisniowski Connected discovered
dhcp_confirm.description:
Home Assistant discovered a possible Wisniowski Connected module on your network.

Hostname: `{hostname}`
Host: `{host}`

Continue to sign in with the Wisniowski Connected account that owns this gate. Discovery only starts setup; control still uses the official cloud API.
